configure terminal

Enter configuration commands, one per line. End with CNTL/Z.

host01(config)# interface vlan 3900


host01(config-if)# ip dhcp relay address 192.0.2.249 use-vrf nxos-routing-admin

                       ^
% Invalid command at '^' marker.

host01(config-if)# exit


host01(config)# end


host01#
